title: TransactionDelta
description: Represents the quantitative change (delta) applied to a transaction ledger or account balance. This schema incorporates the 'C03 Safety Clamp' protocol, which strictly validates that no single transaction delta exceeds a magnitude of 1 Trillion (1T) units. This prevents integer overflow exploits and catastrophic logic errors in high-frequency trading environments.

deltaId.description: Unique version 4 UUID identifying this specific delta calculation event.

changeAmount.description: The net numerical change to be applied. This value is strictly validated against the C03 Safety Clamp limits. It must be greater than or equal to -1,000,000,000,000 and less than or equal to 1,000,000,000,000.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code representing the unit of account for this delta.

precision.description: The number of decimal places considered significant in the changeAmount.

isClamped.description: A flag indicating if the original requested delta exceeded the C03 safety limits and was automatically clamped to the maximum allowable magnitude. If true, an audit log entry is required.

clampReason.description: If isClamped is true, this field provides the specific reason code (e.g., 'C03_MAX_EXCEEDED', 'C03_MIN_EXCEEDED').

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the delta was calculated.

sourceTransactionId.description: Reference to the parent transaction that generated this delta.

integrityHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the deltaId, changeAmount, and timestamp to ensure immutability during transit.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs for additional context regarding the delta calculation.
